title: Add items to cart
story: As a shopper, I want to add products to my cart so that I can buy several items in one order.
acceptance_criteria: Adding an in-stock product increases the cart line quantity by the selected amount.
Quantity per line is limited to 1-10.
Out-of-stock products cannot be added and show a clear message.

title: Apply a discount code
story: As a shopper, I want to apply a discount code so that I get the advertised price.
acceptance_criteria: A valid percentage code reduces the subtotal by that percentage.
Expired codes are rejected with the message 'This code has expired'.
Only one code can be applied per order.

title: Calculate shipping
story: As a shopper, I want to see the shipping cost before paying so that there are no surprises.
acceptance_criteria: Orders of $50.00 or more ship free.
The free-shipping threshold uses the subtotal after discounts.

title: Calculate sales tax
story: As a shopper, I want tax calculated correctly for my state so that my total is accurate.
acceptance_criteria: Tax is applied to the discounted subtotal, not to shipping.
Tax is rounded half-up to 2 decimal places.
Unsupported states block checkout with a clear message.

title: Place an order
story: As a shopper, I want to place my order so that I receive a confirmation number.
acceptance_criteria: A successful order returns a confirmation number in the format SE-XXXXXX.
An empty cart cannot be checked out.
Stock is reduced only after payment succeeds.

title: Pay with saved card
story: As a returning shopper, I want to pay with a saved card so that checkout is faster.
acceptance_criteria: Saved cards show only the brand and last 4 digits.
Expired saved cards cannot be selected.
A declined payment keeps the cart intact and shows the decline reason.
